pwsbuilder January 8, 2018

2022 Officers and Executive Board Members

Executive Board Meetings are open to all members and are held at 9:30 AM-noon the second Monday of the month from September through June, at the Harwich Community Center, 100 Oak St., Harwich, MA.

PresidentMichael Rudden
1st Vice PresidentSedona Summer
2nd Vice PresidentKaren Shortsleeve
Meeting SecretaryPhyllis Charles
TreasurerNorman Stafford
Gallery RepresentativeNatalie Stafford
Membership ChairLinda Lieberman
PublicityMichael Rudden
SunshineDonna Tavano
AIP/Alternative venuesSedona Summer
Education and Scholarships*TBD
Bank ShowsSedona Summer
Website AdministratorAaron O'Brien
Social MediaSedona Summer
Board Member at LargeKatherine Vacca
Board Member at LargeLarry Folding

Thank you to former Board Members, Larry Folding and Dave Crestin for their many contributions to the Guild over the several years they’ve served on the Guild’s Board. The Guild greatly benefited from their dedication.

Thank you to all of the board members listed above who have served many years and will continue to support the Guild’s many projects for the next two years. Your efforts are truly appreciated.

Welcome to our two new Board Members, Sally Mahoney and Beverly Mack. We look forward to working with you.
